name: Rights or data concern
about: Raise a nonsensitive licensing, attribution, privacy or data concern
title: "Rights/data concern: "
---

Please identify the release/package hash, exact file and record/field, nature
of the concern, and any eligible public evidence. Do not post personal data,
credentials or restricted excerpts. A public concern does not require you to
assert ownership of a right you do not hold.

For sensitive rights/security concerns, contact rbedekar@zeroinsec.com privately
instead of opening a public issue. Do not send credentials or private backups.

Affected material:

Concern and supporting public locator:

Requested action:

The project will record substantiated objections and any versioned correction
or removal. A takedown cannot recall downstream copies and is not a rights basis.
This issue route becomes active when r-bedekar/hsgraph-open is published.
